item.title: Altadena family displaced by Eaton Fire hit with citations for trailer parked in front of home
item.description: As Eaton Fire survivors work to rebuild, one family is facing another burden. They're living in an RV in front of their home, but they've been getting parking tickets.

item.title: Man charged years after acid attack that severely injured Hofstra student in New York
item.description: An arrest has been made years after a Hofstra student was attacked with acid in New York.

item.title: Honda Prelude 2026: Honda brings back Prelude as a hybrid sports coupe
item.description: The Honda Prelude 2026 is a two-door coupe, as always, but this time it's both green and mean under its stylish skin.

item.title: Hallmark Channel favorite Kristoffer Polaha stars in, directs new movie, 'Mimics'
item.description: Hallmark Channel superstar Kristoffer Polaha is starring in the big screen movie, "Mimics," which also marks his feature film directorial debut.

item.title: Kate Hudson, Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning among Oscars Nominees Luncheon attendees
item.description: It's the most exclusive lunch in Hollywood! We're taking you inside the 2026 Oscars Nominees Luncheon with nominees like Kate Hudson, Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning and more. Watch "The Oscars" LIVE Sunday March 15 on ABC and Hulu.

item.title: Hollywood fire that killed 2 sisters was caused by arson, is connected to nearby fires, LAPD says
item.description: A house fire that killed two sisters in their Hollywood home is now being investigated as a crime, and police tied the fire to others that burned nearby.

item.title: Rain moves into SoCal overnight into Wednesday. We're timing out the showers
item.description: A band of rain will move through Southern California on Tuesday night and into Wednesday morning.

item.title: Desert community of Trona devastated by mass layoffs at mining facility
item.description: Nearly seven years ago, three powerful earthquakes rocked the city of Trona. Now, residents say 300 layoffs at the largest employer in town are perhaps causing even more devastation.

item.title: DD Café in Garden Grove shut down for alleged nudity and illegal alcohol sales
item.description: Investigators shut down DD Café in Garden Grove and made 17 arrests after there were complaints of nudity and illegal alcohol sales on the premises.

item.title: Orange County hiker reunites with first responders who saved him after fall
item.description: The 21-year-old had multiple broken ribs, a lacerated liver and a punctured lung, and if it wasn't for the Orange County Fire Authority's high-risk helicopter rescue, he may not have survived.
